title: Host guidance says to set noContinuation on a fully handled page, but native relay mailboxes refuse it with 400
outcome: The guidance and tool description a session sees state the limit for native relay mailboxes, so an agent doesn't hit a refusal following them.
acceptance: Guidance and tool descriptions shown to a session say that noContinuation isn't available on native relay mailboxes, matching the refusal, and a behaviour test covers the existing refusal if none does.
Review pair with no Medium or higher and the normal checks.
